title: EDGE_SUPREMACY_DOCTRINE
universal_lens: Edge Supremacy Doctrine unifies information processing and temporal dynamics into a hierarchical Bayesian framework where\( \mathcal{E} = \mathcal{M} \times \mathcal{T} \times \mathcal{C} \) represents the total edge space, with\( \mathcal{M} \) as model class,\( \mathcal{T} \) as temporal layer, and\( \mathcal{C} \) as causal context.
gsi_mapping: GSI maps edge space\( \mathcal{E} \) via conformal predictive distributions using\( \mathbb{P}(X|\mathcal{D}) \), where\( \mathcal{D} \) is the data stack and\( X \) is the outcome variable, enabling robust uncertainty quantification across all\( \mathcal{C} \)-classes.
gse_mapping: GSE encodes\( \mathcal{E} \) as a Markovian state transition system\( \mathcal{S}_{t+1} = f(\mathcal{S}_t, \mathcal{I}_t) \), where\( \mathcal{I}_t \) is the information input stream, enabling real-time tactical reasoning and dynamic policy updates.

primitives.name: Weather Nowcasting

primitives.assumptions: Hourly weather data is available and impacts game outcomes and betting behavior.

layer2.mapping: Transforms weather deltas into dynamic pricing adjustments in GSI's risk layer.
layer2.telemetry: Frequency of repricing events per game

Each primitive is a kernel in this space, with C1.2, C1.3, and C1.4 representing information sources that feed into\( \mathcal{M} \). The doctrine's core insight is that edges are not static but emerge from the interaction of these layers. For example, the transaction wire scanner (C1.2) provides a temporal signal that informs model predictions, while practice report trajectories (C1.3) introduce a decayed probabilistic structure. Weather nowcasting (C1.4) introduces a dynamic perturbation that triggers repricing events. These primitives form a dual structure: one side is the information processing pipeline (GSI), the other is the tactical execution engine (GSE). Failure modes arise when temporal signals are misaligned with model expectations, or when contextual rules are not updated in response to new data. The doctrine's strength lies in its recursive validation through masterplan gates, ensuring each edge is vetted before deployment.
